limitations: Local 15-second constant-VU snapshots are not production SLOs or a sustainable capacity envelope.
The historical runner sent command traffic only to localhost:8082; this baseline is not multiprocess evidence.
The current runner requires two explicit command-api processes, but its corrected workload has not yet produced a canonical run.
The mixed latency percentiles aggregate read and write requests.
The PostgreSQL lock value is a final snapshot and does not prove zero waits during the run.
Oversell safety is established by integration and concurrency assertions, not by this throughput chart.
The high-load AWS target was not provisioned or benchmarked.
